result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I would shortlist **DocuSign, Signable and Dropbox Sign**\. The best choice depends on how many contracts you send, how many people need access, and whether you want a simple signing tool or a complete document-management system.

If I were choosing for a small business in the UK, I'd start with **Signable for affordability** and **DocuSign for an all-round professional solution**\.

## Best e-signature software compared

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. DocuSign**

(Best overall)

From £8/month; Standard £20/user/month, annual billing.

- Widely recognised by customers and suppliers.
- Reusable contract templates.
- Strong integrations with business software.
- Signing reminders and tracking.

**Best for\:** Businesses wanting a professional, established solution.

[Official pricing and plans](https://ecom.docusign.com/en-GB/plans-and-pricing/esignature?region=GB&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Signable - Sales Enablement and E-Signature App for HubSpot | Signable](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gGvZ428-QbTIsXWx5S3s4zb6kZDelI9e6ZN1kcrVXolj1eCD-CGWYpJUWQVhaaNegb8o5414_h9QprmHzoP6h5tK6DtY4aVvKfnST-Ll6yIMrl8U2ytx_iGlhlJQGLqoqEbDe6PtiDf5VDUiYl3n5stFymYFaK57eWdPcCBx7o-QM2JljTdOAGcEYS_3vHeI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Signable**

(Best for UK small businesses)

Pay as you go from £2.60 per envelope; Essentials £40 + VAT/month, annually.

- UK-based e-signature provider.
- Unlimited users on its plans.
- Advanced electronic signatures.
- Two-factor authentication for signers.
- Good for teams sharing responsibility for contracts.

**Best for\:** Small teams that want predictable costs without paying for every employee.

[Official pricing and plans](https://www.signable.com/plans/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![PandaDoc Review: Sign, Seal, Deliver](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/0MUKV24vOJ8Fy84anuzrEeDfSf0kpDjVQFizvzFH_No27CWsxijbo2OMMlOGpvgS85vZB3wg04yrL3uUEA8HfUdyjeWSSz3aH8VUzmHL1gINYfR2lzt9WJR1seELOV2zEpePqA9WPggyXDEs9xtNtG6ptm3fJ7rmZx4q6N4W7fYpmzjZfQx9dTipSbsTdrj3?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Dropbox Sign**

From £11.67/month, annually.

- Very straightforward to use.
- Reusable templates.
- Automatic reminders.
- Audit trails for signed documents.
- Works particularly well with Dropbox.

**Best for\:** Freelancers and small businesses that want uncomplicated signing.

[Official pricing and features](https://sign.dropbox.com/en-GB/products/dropbox-sign?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PandaDoc**

Free tier available; paid plans from around £15–£20 per user/month depending on billing and region.

- Create professional proposals and quotations.
- Build reusable document templates.
- Track when customers open documents.
- Collect signatures and manage sales documents.

**Best for\:** Businesses regularly sending proposals, quotations and sales contracts.

---

![Adobe Acrobat Sign Solutions for business Transaction New](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/boFV63978924LtJqDW6sL1JIitAIaS-BthRNk192q0PHK-HvHdZBMxqDjDCO72LE2oPF1ayxecsE94Q-YPvxHO-S7Mi38P9TmXNhPAUlm7-8leU4NJBCSUCriipzFK7eQRBF1P54X7oN4viJGvAqlvPFeHJwJMDSU5H8EIj-uBFDS8q0gO8ZF29lIfJEU-lB?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Adobe Acrobat Sign**

Pricing depends on the Acrobat or business plan.

- Excellent PDF editing capabilities.
- Signing and document preparation together.
- Useful Microsoft 365 integration.
- Good for businesses already using Adobe.

**Best for\:** Businesses handling lots of PDF documents.

## My recommendation

| Your situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| One-person business | Dropbox Sign |
| Small team of 2–10 people | Signable |
| Professional client contracts | DocuSign |
| Sales proposals and quotations | PandaDoc |
| Lots of PDF editing | Adobe Acrobat Sign |


**One important consideration\:** Don't just compare monthly prices. Check how many documents you can send (often called envelopes), whether the limit is per user or shared across the business, and whether you pay extra for identity verification.

For UK businesses, also check that the signature type is appropriate for the document. Electronic signatures are generally recognised under UK law, but certain documents have additional formalities. DocuSign offers simple, advanced and qualified signature options. search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
